reason: Based on repository evidence, this is a utility-style DSH plugin that fetches DeepSeek account balance from the official API and computes local usage costs for Flash/Pro from saved sessions, then displays them in a DSH web sidebar entry; primary scope is external-service billing visibility with a small local data-processing surface.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 界面的侧边栏入口中展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按本机会话统计 Flash/Pro 的消费金额。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a DSH web sidebar panel that shows your DeepSeek account balance and local Flash/Pro usage cost statistics.

capabilities: Calls an external DeepSeek balance API endpoint
Reads local DSH session records to calculate usage cost
Provides local host routes for panel data retrieval
Injects a web UI entry/panel into DSH

reasons.code: The README states it uses DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and a host-side request to the DeepSeek balance endpoint.
The README defines local routes `GET /api/deepseek-balance` and `GET /api/deepseek-balance/usage` used to supply panel data.
The package manifest marks DSH client integration for the web platform and includes bundle registration files, confirming plugin runtime and UI behavior.
